					Fork Force prides itself on fast delivery. The specific delivery time may vary depending on your location and the availability of the desired forklift model.
				
							
					
													
															
								
														
												Are the forklifts serviced before hire?
					
					Yes, all forklifts are fully serviced before each hire agreement to ensure they are in excellent working order.
				
							
					
													
															
								
														
												Do you offer support and parts backup?
					
					Yes, Fork Force provides comprehensive servicing and parts backup to ensure your hired forklift remains operational throughout the hire period.

					Yes, Fork Force offers flexible hire terms that allow you to adjust the length of your hire period based on your changing business needs.

					Don’t Let Downtime Hit Your Bottom Line.				
				
				
				
																														
				
				
				
									Your forklift can help keep your operations moving smoothly, safely, and on schedule. But every now and then, you might start to notice the little warning signs creep up. Maybe the lifting doesn’t feel as strong as it used to, the mast gets a bit shaky, the steering reacts slowly, or the whole machine decides it doesn’t want to start at all. Those mechanical hiccups can snowball quickly if you leave them for too long. You might also spot safety-related issues: lights that stop working, brakes that don’t feel as sharp, or forks and attachments showing a bit too many dings and dents. Then there’s the usual wear and tear – worn tyres, a bit of smoke, odd leaks or strange noises. And sometimes the warning signs are right in front of you: flashing dashboard lights, electrical faults, system errors or a battery that just won’t hold its charge. These issues can cause your operations to slow down – or worse: grind to a halt.								
				
					
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
				
					The longer you wait, the more you lose.				
				
				
				
									The more you turn a blind eye to these signs, the more it’ll cost you – in time, money, and productivity. Without regular maintenance and servicing, you increase the risk of safety, which can damage your team, inventory, and reputation. When unexpected breakdowns happen (and they will), you’ll also foot a huge bill that could have been avoided. And while your forklift is down, your competitors are moving ahead. 								
				
					
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
				
					forklift service &amp; repair with fork force				
				
				
				
					Boost Lifespan &amp; Long-Term Value.				
				
				
				
									 Forklift servicing is one of the smartest investments you can make for your business.  Whether you need a one-off forklift service, urgent forklift repairs, or ongoing scheduled maintenance, staying on top of your forklift’s health is one of the most effective ways to get the most value out of your unit.  Regular forklift servicing helps you stay compliant with warranty requirements, ensures everything is working as it should, and catches small issues before they turn into major breakdowns.  Even a single service or repair can restore performance, improve safety, and get your operations back on track. And with consistent maintenance, you’ll extend the life of your forklift, reduce unexpected repair bills, and minimise downtime.   No matter the brand, age, or workload of your equipment, proper forklift servicing and repair support keeps your business productive – and your forklift performing at its best for the long haul.

					TCM Forklifts For Sale				
				
				
				
									The TCM brand, which stands for Toyo Carriers Manufacturing Co., Ltd., has long been established as a reputable supplier of counterbalance and forklift trucks. Its history spans over 60 years, and it remains as a leader in the advancement of forklift design, engineering and technology. As the pioneer in innovating, developing and manufacturing durable fork truck products, TCM stands on solid ground as a global brand. From the earliest designs, TCM forklifts continue to evolve as the industry’s demands change.We understand that each and every truck needs to meet a certain requirement so that it can serve a specific purpose, which is why we have a large range of second hand and used TCM forklifts, with varying load capacities to suit most applications:								
				
				
				
									⮞ TCM 1.5 Ton Forklift⮞ TCM 1.8 Ton Forklift⮞ TCM 2 Ton Forklift⮞ TCM 2.5 Ton Forklift⮞ TCM 3 Ton Forklift⮞ TCM 3.5 Ton Forklift⮞ TCM 4.5 Ton Forklift⮞ TCM 5 Ton Forklift⮞ TCM 7 Ton Forklift⮞ TCM 8 Ton ForkliftIn addition to a wide range of load carrying capacities, available in our inventory are forklift trucks that run on different fuel types: TCM diesel, electric, petrol and LPG forklift trucks. Depending on your application, there is an ideal fuel type that fits the requirement. If you are unsure, below is a quick rundown on the pros and cons on each fuel type.								
				
				
				
					

Fuel Type
Advantages
Disadvantages

TCM Diesel Forklift
&nbsp;
Best for outdoor use; more power; quick refuel times; less operational costs compared to LPG.
Needs ventilation; diesel engines are louder than the others; produces more emission and carbon monoxide compared to LPG and Petrol.

TCM Electric Forklift
&nbsp;
Best for small areas and indoor use; environment-friendly; longer lifespan; quiet engine.
Battery charging cycles can take some time; most not appropriate to operate in wet weather.

TCM LPG and Petrol Forklift
&nbsp;
Better suited to heavier handling and in outdoor areas; can be used indoors, if area is well-ventilated; lower carbon emissions compared to diesel; quick to swap gas tanks.
LPG fuel can be dangerous due to potential safety hazards when mishandled by operator.

Regardless of your location, we are more than happy to provide you with the forklift that fits your needs, as our second hand forklifts have been workshopped, safety-checked and primed for delivery. We also offer a range of fuel types, from petrol and LPG to diesel and lithium and battery electric forklifts.
				
							
					
													
															
								
														
												How long can I hire a forklift for?
					
					You can hire a forklift for any period ranging from one day to seven years. Fork Force offers both short-term and long-term hire options.
				
							
					
													
															
								
														
												What are the payment options available?
					
					Fork Force provides flexible payment options tailored to meet your specific needs, whether for short-term or long-term hire.

				
							
					
													
															
								
														
												How quickly can I get a forklift delivered?
					
					Fork Force prides itself on fast delivery. The specific delivery time may vary depending on your location and the availability of the desired forklift model.
				
							
					
													
															
								
														
												Are the forklifts serviced before hire?
					
					Yes, all forklifts are fully serviced before each hire agreement to ensure they are in excellent working order.
				
							
					
													
															
								
														
												Do you offer support and parts backup?

					Why Buy a Used Forklift?				
				
				
				
									Purchasing a used forklift can be an ideal choice for many businesses, offering numerous advantages over buying new. The most significant benefit is cost savings. Used forklifts are typically much more affordable than new models, allowing you to invest in high-quality equipment without breaking the budget. Additionally, used forklifts can provide immediate availability, reducing downtime and keeping your operations running smoothly.With proper maintenance and servicing, second-hand forklifts can offer reliability and longevity similar to new ones. At Fork Force Australia, we ensure all our used forklifts undergo rigorous safety checks and servicing, ensuring you receive a dependable machine that meets your operational needs.								
				
					
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
				
					Renting a Used Forklift				
				
				
				
									Opting to rent a used forklift from Fork Force Australia presents several benefits over purchasing a new one. Renting allows you to access high-quality equipment without the upfront cost and long-term commitment associated with buying. This is especially beneficial for projects or seasonal workloads where you need additional forklifts temporarily.Hiring a used forklift also offers flexibility in your operations and budget management. You can scale your fleet up or down based on demand without the burden of ownership. Moreover, our rental forklifts are well-maintained, ensuring reliable performance throughout the rental period from short-term to long-term.To learn more about our used forklift rental options or to discuss your specific requirements, contact the team at Fork Force Australia today. We are here to help you find the right forklift solution for your business.

Used forklifts also depreciate slower than new ones, maintaining their value better over time.Secondly, availability is another key advantage. Unlike new forklifts that may require waiting periods, used forklifts for sale are ready for immediate deployment, minimising downtime.

From the irrigated farms and food processing facilities of the Murrumbidgee Irrigation Area and the grain receival terminals of the Murray Plains to the defence logistics infrastructure of Kapooka and Wagga Wagga Air Base, the freight depots of the Sturt and Olympic Highway corridors and the wineries and cool stores of the Riverina wine region, the breadth of industrial activity across Wagga Wagga and its surrounding catchment is unlike any other region.
With over 25 years of experience in delivering tailored material handling solutions to Australians, Fork Force continues to supply Wagga Wagga forklifts and telehandlers to businesses of every size across the Riverina and the Murray – backed by local specialists who understand the unique demands of the region. #### Roll Over Bin
Designed for smooth tipping action, this roll-over bin reduces impact when emptying contents. Side bearings prevent dislodgement which is common with roll-over bins, and the cut-away front lip makes it ideal for tipping liquids. 
To tip the bin, the operator will simply need to pull the draw rope from the drivers seat. Bin capacities are available from 0.9 to 1.7 cubic metres in enamel over primed steel or HD galvanised finish. 
Safe working load is 1000kg and bin options include drain valve and strainer, crane lugs, and cast iron or rubber wheels.

#### Self Dumping Bin Tipper
The self-dumping bin tipper attachment with reinforced edges is an economical solution to industrial waste collection and disposal. Waste materials can be gathered at the point of manufacture.
With forklift tines positioned fully beneath the bin, theres no lost load as the forklifts lifting capacity is completely utilised. The operator empties the bin by placing its front feet inside the dumpsters edge, then drives in reverse until tines are beyond the pivot point. The bin tips forward when the tines are raised.
Bins can be stacked up to 3 high and are supplied in enamel or zinc finish.

#### Sideshift Fork Positioner
Our sideshift positioners provide practical and cost-efficient solutions to the handling of palletised loads. Operator productivity is significantly enhanced while risk of damage to goods is reduced. 
Designed is with the truck operator in mind, this sideshift positioner offers excellent visibility and accurate fork positioning while delivering very high residual capacity and minimising lost load.
The attachment is easy to install and requires no welding. Different widths, capacities and load guard options available.

#### Slip-On Bulk Bag Forklift Jib
This slip-on bulk bag jib attachment comes with 4 lifting points that work with standard bulk bags. Four safety swivel hooks are supplied with the bulk bag jib which comes with a Safe Working Load (SWL) of 2000kg.
Note: AS2359.1 guidelines specify that net lifting capacity should be 0.8 times the forklift rating to allow for swinging load when lifting with a jib attachment.

#### Slip-On Dirt Bucket
Slip-on dirt buckets are indispensable in keeping a clean work environment. Built with hardened steel wear edge for added durability, theyre especially valuable in the removal of loose materials such as grain, gravel, coal or debris from surface areas.
This slip-on attachment suits most forklift models without any adaptation and requires no tools for fitting. Dumping action is carried out with a simple mechanical lever control.
Dirt buckets are available in enamel painted or galvanised finish.

#### Standard Push Pull with Slip Sheeting
What is a push-pull?
Push-pulls allow you to handle goods with slip sheets instead of wooden pallets. Substituting a wooden pallet by an inexpensive slip sheet will help you decrease maintenance costs, storage area and damaged stock due to old and damaged pallets.
Push-pulls are commonly used in industries such as food and beverage, construction, to name but a few. The push-pull attachment is only available for forklifts.
&nbsp;
What are the benefits of a push-pull?
By using this attachment you will:
• save significantly in material handling costs.
• eliminate the need for pallet exchange.
• increase container shipping volume.
• decrease the risk of damaged stock.
&nbsp;
What options are available?
There are several options available to tailor your push-pull forklift attachment to your exact application needs. Options include:
• Capacity range: from 1600 kg to 2000 kg
• Hook-on or fork-mounted
• With or without sheet retainer
&nbsp;
Need more information?
Do not hesitate to contact us if you have any questions regarding our push-pulls. We are happy to help you!
